title: Disabling Engram on a project silently turns its Execution Observability back on
outcome: Disabling Engram on a project keeps that project's Execution Observability setting unchanged. A request that omits executionObservability inherits the current value, as an omitted acceptanceEvaluation already does.
acceptance: A PATCH to the project Engram settings that omits executionObservability keeps the stored value (covered by a backend test that disables a project whose observations are OFF and asserts they stay OFF).
The UI Disable action either sends the current executionObservability or relies on the backend inheritance; a UI test shows that a project with observations OFF still shows OFF after Disable.

completion.summary: Disabling Engram on a project keeps its Execution Observability setting. The backend fix landed earlier; this landing adds the UI test. On master 7f8d1b63, gated by test-78f5f61f.
